\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The window lies on a vertical edge, dark on the left and bright on the right.

| Output | Value |
|---|---|
| Gx | 540 |
| Gy | 0 |
| Magnitude (L2) | 540 |

Gx = (200 - 20) x (1 + 1 + 1) = 540. The three rows count equally. Sobel gives 720 here, because it weights the middle row by 2.
